rows.finding: THE PUBLISHED PROFILE CONTRADICTS ITS OWN SOURCE. The live record says pets_allowed=true with a $150 non-refundable per-stay fee, cited from the quote 'Pets Welcome' captured 2026-08-17. The page captured 2026-08-23 -- six days later, same property, hash-bound -- reads 'Pets are not allowed. Only service animals are welcome. Non-Refundable Pet Fee Per Stay: $150.00'. The current hardened parser withholds pets_allowed as SOURCE_CONTRADICTORY and raises FLAG_CONTRADICTS_OFFICIAL. It is NOT a parser defect: the parser is right and the surface really does say both. The $150 line appears in both captures, which is what makes it contradictory rather than a clean reversal.
rows.safe_fields: none -- pets_allowed cannot be stated in either direction from this page
rows.recommended_disposition: FOUNDER DECISION REQUIRED. This is the only row here with a LIVE guest-visible consequence: PetTripFinder currently publishes a pet-friendly profile for a property whose own page says pets are not allowed. Options: (a) WITHDRAW the published record pending re-capture, (b) REPUBLISH as VERIFIED_NO_PETS on the newer evidence, (c) HOLD both and re-capture. I cannot withdraw founder-approved authority on my own.
rows.affects: AUTHORITY (a published profile) + routing if withdrawn
rows.adds_a_profile: no -- it REMOVES or REVERSES an existing profile
